description: Evidence matrix and GO decision table artifacts for the APG-6 lipidation-cycle hypothesis
code:
import pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, numpy as np, os
os.makedirs("out", exist_ok=True)

# ---------- artifact 1: evidence matrix ----------
ev = pd.DataFrame([
 dict(citation="PMID 11038174 (Kirisako 2000, JCB)", type="direct assay",
      stance="supports", claim="Atg4 removes the residue(s) C-terminal to Gly116 of Atg8, exposing glycine",
      finding="Yeast Apg8 C-terminal Arg117 removed by Apg4, leaving Gly116 as C-terminus (Apg8FG)",
      context="S. cerevisiae, in vivo + in vitro", confidence="high; reference organism, not N. crassa"),
 dict(citation="PMID 11100732 (Ichimura 2000, Nature)", type="direct assay",
      stance="supports", claim="Exposed C-terminal Gly is the PE acceptor; Atg7 E1 and Atg3 E2 required",
      finding="Amide bond between Atg8 C-terminal Gly and PE amino group; Atg7->Atg3 route",
      context="S. cerevisiae, mass spectrometry + genetics", confidence="high; defines the feature set tested"),
 dict(citation="PMID 19021777 (Noda 2008, Genes Cells); PDB 2ZPN",
      type="structural", stance="supports",
      claim="Two hydrophobic pockets of Atg8 capture Trp and Leu of a WxxL AIM",
      finding="15 Atg8 residues contact the Atg19 WEEL peptide; HP1 and HP2 defined",
      context="S. cerevisiae Atg8 crystal structure", confidence="high; source of the contact set"),
 dict(citation="This work (UniProt Q8WZY7 + NW alignment)", type="computational",
      stance="supports", claim="APG-6 has Gly at the Atg4-exposed position with a cleavable extension",
      finding="78.6% id to yeast Atg8; Gly116 aligns 1:1; 110-SGENTFG-116 identical; 117-DFETA-121 propeptide",
      context="sequence", confidence="high for the residue call; cannot prove cleavage occurs"),
 dict(citation="This work (PDB 2ZPN contact map + alignment)", type="structural/computational",
      stance="supports", claim="AIM-docking surface is conserved in APG-6",
      finding="15/15 AIM contacts identical (13/13 pocket-lining); 100% vs 78.6% background, binomial p=0.027",
      context="structure-guided homology", confidence="high conservation; no measured APG-6 interaction"),
 dict(citation="This work (UniProt proteome 367110)", type="computational",
      stance="supports", claim="N. crassa encodes the enzymes the cycle needs",
      finding="atg4/cpr-1 NCU02433 (C226/D399/H401), atg7/apg-5 NCU06672 (C550), atg3/apg-3 NCU01955 (C238)",
      context="genome annotation + alignment", confidence="high presence call; no enzyme assay in N. crassa"),
 dict(citation="PMID 21965514 (Park 2011)", type="mutant phenotype",
      stance="qualifies", claim="The autophagy pathway is functional in N. crassa",
      finding="apg-1 (NCU00188) deletion gives growth, development and chemical-sensitivity defects",
      context="N. crassa, kinase deletion collection", confidence="moderate; pathway-level, not apg-6"),
 dict(citation="PMID 25333968 (Chinnici 2014)", type="mutant phenotype",
      stance="qualifies", claim="Autophagy genes act in N. crassa female development",
      finding="Autophagy genes needed to mobilise nutrients into developing protoperithecia",
      context="N. crassa, screen of 68 genes", confidence="moderate; apg-6 not individually named"),
 dict(citation="PMID 37847028 (Rivetta 2023)", type="localization/morphology",
      stance="qualifies", claim="Autophagic structures form in N. crassa",
      finding="Carbon starvation triggers vacuolation and phagophore-like double-membrane structures",
      context="N. crassa, EM/light microscopy", confidence="moderate; no molecular marker for APG-6"),
 dict(citation="PMID 23380892 (Duan 2013)", type="mutant phenotype",
      stance="supports", claim="Propeptide length beyond the cleavage Gly is not functionally limiting",
      finding="MrATG8 deletion impairs autophagy; C-terminus beyond the cleavage site is dispensable",
      context="Metarhizium robertsii, filamentous ascomycete", confidence="moderate; orthologous organism"),
 dict(citation="PMID 38663545 (Barz 2024, review)", type="review",
      stance="qualifies", claim="C-terminal extensions are the norm and require priming",
      finding="Most ATG8 proteins carry extra residues shielding the Gly; unprimed forms not detected in vivo",
      context="review", confidence="orientation only"),
 dict(citation="No paper found", type="absence of evidence",
      stance="qualifies", claim="APG-6 processing/lipidation demonstrated in N. crassa",
      finding="No deletion, GFP-ATG8, PE-conjugation or Atg4-cleavage assay reported for NCU01545",
      context="PubMed searches, Nov 2026", confidence="high that none was found; absence is not proof"),
])
ev.to_csv("out/evidence_matrix_apg6.csv", index=False)
print("=== EVIDENCE MATRIX ===")
for _,r in ev.iterrows():
    print(f"\n[{r.stance.upper():9s}] {r.citation}  ({r['type']})")
    print(f"   claim   : {r.claim}")
    print(f"   finding : {r.finding}")
    print(f"   context : {r.context} | {r.confidence}")

# ---------- artifact 2: GO decision table ----------
go = pd.DataFrame([
 dict(aspect="MF", term="GO:0031386 protein tag / GO:0019776 Atg8 ligase activity substrate",
      current_basis="PAINT / ISS from P38182",
      verdict="retain, keep ISS/IBA evidence", reason="Gly116 + intact Atg4/Atg7/Atg3 make the modifier role predictable; no N. crassa assay exists"),
 dict(aspect="MF", term="GO:0008429 phosphatidylethanolamine binding / lipid conjugation",
      current_basis="ISS", verdict="retain as ISS, do not upgrade",
      reason="Conjugation is covalent and predicted, not measured in N. crassa"),
 dict(aspect="BP", term="GO:0000045 autophagosome assembly / GO:0006914 autophagy",
      current_basis="PAINT / ISS", verdict="retain",
      reason="Pathway demonstrably operates in N. crassa (PMID 37847028, 21965514); APG-6 is the single ATG8"),
 dict(aspect="BP", term="GO:0000422 mitophagy, GO:0044804 nucleophagy",
      current_basis="ISS from S. cerevisiae Atg8",
      verdict="consider narrowing or demoting to non-core", reason="Selective-autophagy subtypes carried over from yeast; no N. crassa receptor or cargo evidence. The conserved HP1/HP2 surface makes the capacity plausible but not the specific cargo."),
 dict(aspect="CC", term="GO:0000421 autophagosome membrane, lipid anchor",
      current_basis="UniProt SubCell ISS", verdict="retain as ISS",
      reason="Follows from predicted lipidation; no imaging of APG-6 in N. crassa"),
 dict(aspect="MF", term="candidate addition: GO:0030674 protein-macromolecule adaptor activity (AIM/LIR docking)",
      current_basis="not annotated", verdict="lead only, do not add without a measured interaction",
      reason="15/15 AIM-contact residues conserved, but no N. crassa receptor binding has been shown"),
])
go.to_csv("out/go_decision_table_apg6.csv", index=False)
print("\n\n=== GO DECISION TABLE ===")
print(go.to_string(index=False, max_colwidth=78))

# ---------- figure: stance summary ----------
fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,4.6))
ax=axes[0]
order=["supports","qualifies"]
cnt=ev.groupby(["type","stance"]).size().unstack(fill_value=0).reindex(columns=order,fill_value=0)
cnt=cnt.loc[cnt.sum(1).sort_values().index]
b=np.zeros(len(cnt))
for s,c in zip(order,["#1f6f4a","#c8922a"]):
    ax.barh(cnt.index,cnt[s],left=b,color=c,label=s); b=b+cnt[s].values
ax.set_xlabel("number of evidence items"); ax.legend(fontsize=9)
ax.set_title("Evidence for the APG-6 lipidation-cycle hypothesis\n(no item refutes it; none is a direct N. crassa assay)",fontsize=10)

ax=axes[1]
req=["Gly at Atg4-exposed\nposition (G116)","Cleavable C-terminal\nextension (DFETA)","Atg4 protease\n(NCU02433, C226)",
     "Atg7 E1\n(NCU06672, C550)","Atg3 E2\n(NCU01955, C238)","HP1 W-site\n(8/8 identical)","HP2 L-site\n(7/7 identical)",
     "Demonstrated in\nN. crassa"]
val=[1,1,1,1,1,1,1,0]
col=["#1f6f4a"]*7+["#b03a2e"]
ax.barh(range(len(req)),val,color=col)
ax.set_yticks(range(len(req))); ax.set_yticklabels(req,fontsize=8)
ax.set_xticks([0,1]); ax.set_xticklabels(["absent / not shown","present"],fontsize=9)
ax.invert_yaxis()
ax.set_title("Requirements for the ATG8 processing and lipidation cycle",fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
